074        @Override
075        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
076                // if already accepted by the player, abort
077                if (!setGlobalReference("$bffi_ref", "$bffi_inProgress")) {
078                        return false;
079                }
080                
081                // Places
082                chalcedon = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("chalcedon");
083                if (chalcedon == null) return false;
084                if (!chalcedon.getFactionId().equals(Factions.LUDDIC_PATH)) return false;
085                
086                gilead = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("gilead");
087                if (gilead == null) return false;
088                if (!gilead.getFactionId().equals(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH)) return false;
089                
090                kazeron = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("kazeron");
091                if (kazeron == null) return false;
092                if (!kazeron.getFactionId().equals(Factions.PERSEAN)) return false;
093                
094                olinadu = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("olinadu");
095                if (olinadu == null) return false;
096                if (!olinadu.getFactionId().equals(Factions.PERSEAN)) return false;
097                
098                hesperus = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("hesperus");
099                if (hesperus == null) return false;
100                if (!hesperus.getFactionId().equals(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH)) return false;
101                
102                tartessus = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("tartessus");
103                if (tartessus == null) return false;
104                if (!tartessus.getFactionId().equals(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH)) return false;
105                
106                asher = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("asher");
107                if (asher == null) return false;
108                if (!asher.getFactionId().equals(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH)) return false;
109                
110                
111                // People
112                
113                bornanew = getImportantPerson(People.BORNANEW);
114                if (bornanew == null) return false;
115
116                jaspis = getImportantPerson(People.JASPIS);
117                if (bornanew == null) return false;
118                
119                ulmus_pond = getImportantPerson(People.ULMUS_POND);
120                if (ulmus_pond == null) return false;
121                
122                menes_yaribay = getImportantPerson(People.MENES_YARIBAY);
123                if (menes_yaribay == null) return false;
124                
125                horus_yaribay = getImportantPerson(People.HORUS_YARIBAY);
126                if (horus_yaribay == null) return false;
127                
128                cedra_keepfaith = getImportantPerson(People.CEDRA_KEEPFAITH);
129                if (cedra_keepfaith == null) return false;
130                
131                
132                // Find a system to hide Pather base in
133                resetSearch();
134                requireSystemTags(ReqMode.ANY, Tags.THEME_MISC, Tags.THEME_MISC_SKIP, Tags.THEME_RUINS);
135                requireSystemTags(ReqMode.NOT_ANY, Tags.THEME_UNSAFE, Tags.THEME_CORE, Tags.SYSTEM_ALREADY_USED_FOR_STORY);
136                requireSystemNotAlreadyUsedForStory();
137                requireSystemNotHasPulsar(); // don't want the challenge to get blown up.
138                preferSystemOnFringeOfSector();
139                preferSystemUnexplored();
140                preferSystemInDirectionOfOtherMissions(); 
141                patherBaseSystem = pickSystem();
142                if (patherBaseSystem == null) return false;
143
144                setStoryMission();
145                
146                setStartingStage(Stage.PICK_UP_BORNANEW);
147                connectWithGlobalFlag(Stage.PICK_UP_BORNANEW, Stage.MEET_MENES_YARIBAY, "$bffi_goMeetMenesYaribay");
148                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.ATTEND_A_PARTY, "$bffi_gotPartyInvite");
149                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.TALK_TO_HORUS, "$bffi_goTalkToHorus");
150                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.TALK_TO_ENGINEER, "$bffi_talkToEngineer");
151                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.TALK_TO_ULMUS_POND, "$bffi_talkToUlmusPond");
152                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.GO_TO_CHALCEDON, "$bffi_followUlmusPond");
153                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.INVESTIGATE_PATHER_STATION, "$bffi_investigatePatherStation");
154                
155                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.ARREST_THE_CURATE, "$bffi_arrestTheCurate"); // for testing.
156                
157                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.RETURN_TO_HESPERUS_EARLY, "$bffi_destroyedStationEarly"); // half-failure.
158                
159                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.GO_TO_HESPERUS, "$bffi_returnBornanewBody"); // definitely a failure
160                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.GO_TO_HESPERUS, "$bffi_keepfaithEscapedTartessus"); // half-failure.
161                
162                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.ARREST_THE_CURATE, "$bffi_learnedAboutKeepfaith");
163                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.DELIVER_KEEPFAITH, "$bffi_arrestedKeepfaith");
164                
165                
166                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, "$bffi_completed");
167                addSuccessStages(Stage.COMPLETED);      
168                
169                makeImportant(bornanew, "$bffi_pickUpBornanew", Stage.PICK_UP_BORNANEW);
170                makeImportant(menes_yaribay, "$bffi_meetMenesYaribay", Stage.MEET_MENES_YARIBAY);
171                makeImportant(olinadu, "$bffi_attendAParty", Stage.ATTEND_A_PARTY);
172                makeImportant(horus_yaribay, "$bffi_talkToHorusAboutMenesParty", Stage.TALK_TO_HORUS);
173                
174                makeImportant(asher, "$bffi_talkToEngineer", Stage.TALK_TO_ENGINEER);
175                
176                makeImportant(ulmus_pond, "$bffi_talkToUlmusPond", Stage.TALK_TO_ULMUS_POND);
177                makeImportant(chalcedon, "$bffi_followUlmusPond", Stage.GO_TO_CHALCEDON);
178                
179                makeImportant(tartessus, "$bffi_arrestTheCurate", Stage.ARREST_THE_CURATE);
180                makeImportant(hesperus, "$bffi_deliverKeepfaith", Stage.DELIVER_KEEPFAITH);
181                
182                makeImportant(hesperus, "$bffi_goToHesperus", Stage.GO_TO_HESPERUS);
183                makeImportant(hesperus, "$bffi_goToHesperus", Stage.RETURN_TO_HESPERUS_EARLY);
184
185                setName("False Idols");
186                setRepFactionChangesNone();
187                setRepPersonChangesNone();
188        
189                // Spawn a PL patrol or two to spice up things around Olinadu pre Menes' party
190                beginStageTrigger(Stage.ATTEND_A_PARTY);
191                triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.SMALL, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, Factions.PERSEAN, FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM, olinadu.getPlanetEntity());
192                triggerPickLocationAroundEntity(olinadu.getPlanetEntity(), 1600f);
193                triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation("$gaDHO_arrayFleet", null);
194                triggerOrderFleetPatrol(false, olinadu.getPlanetEntity(), olinadu.getStarSystem().getJumpPoints().get(0));
195                triggerSetFleetMissionRef("$bffi_ref");
196                endTrigger();
197                
198                // And a couple PL patrols for after the party.
199                beginStageTrigger(Stage.TALK_TO_ENGINEER);
200                triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.SMALL, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, Factions.PERSEAN, FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM, olinadu.getPlanetEntity());
201                triggerFleetAllowLongPursuit();
202                triggerPickLocationAroundEntity(olinadu.getPlanetEntity(), 1000f);
203                triggerSetFleetMissionRef("$bffi_ref");
204                triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation("$bffi_postRaidPatrol", null);
205                //triggerOrderFleetPatrol(false, olinadu.getPlanetEntity(), olinadu.getStarSystem().getJumpPoints().get(0), olinadu.getStarSystem().getJumpPoints().get(1));
206                //triggerOrderFleetInterceptPlayer(); // Could write a unique interaction, but I'd want it to have consequences... -dgb
207                endTrigger();
208                
209                beginStageTrigger(Stage.TALK_TO_ENGINEER);
210                triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.SMALL, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, Factions.PERSEAN, FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM, olinadu.getPlanetEntity());
211                triggerSetFleetFaction(Factions.PERSEAN);
212                //triggerAutoAdjustFleetStrengthMajor();
213                triggerPickLocationTowardsEntity(olinadu.getStarSystem().getHyperspaceAnchor(), 30f, getUnits(1.5f));
214                //triggerFleetAllowLongPursuit();
215                triggerSetFleetMissionRef("$bffi_ref");
216                triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation("$bffi_postRaidPatrol", null);
217                triggerOrderFleetPatrol(false, olinadu.getPlanetEntity(), olinadu.getStarSystem().getJumpPoints().get(1));
218                //triggerOrderFleetInterceptPlayer(); // Could write a unique interaction, but I'd want it to have consequences... -dgb
219                endTrigger();
220                
221                
222                // Spawn a Pather fleet near Chalcedon after Pond tips them off (inadvertantly or not)
223                beginWithinHyperspaceRangeTrigger(chalcedon.getPlanetEntity(), 1f, false,Stage.GO_TO_CHALCEDON);
224                triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.MEDIUM, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, Factions.LUDDIC_PATH, FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM, chalcedon.getPlanetEntity());
225                triggerSetFleetFaction(Factions.LUDDIC_PATH);
226        triggerPickLocationAroundEntity(chalcedon.getPlanetEntity(), 800f);
227        triggerOrderFleetPatrol(chalcedon.getPlanetEntity());
228        triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation("$bffi_patherGoblins", null);
229        triggerSetFleetMissionRef("$bffi_ref");
230        
231        // if player is hostile to Path, Path fleet is hostile to player.
232        if( Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.LUDDIC_PATH).getRelToPlayer().isAtBest(RepLevel.HOSTILE)){
233                triggerMakeHostileAndAggressive();
234        }
235        
236        triggerFleetSetPatrolLeashRange(1400f);
237        triggerMakeFleetGoAwayAfterDefeat();
238        endTrigger();
239        
240                // A *serious* Luddic intercept fleet post-Chalcedon
241        // Revenge for killing Sedge and/or the same but stopping player's meddling.
242        // Maybe they demand to talk to Bornanew?
243                beginWithinHyperspaceRangeTrigger(chalcedon, 3f, true, Stage.INVESTIGATE_PATHER_STATION);
244                triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.LARGER, FleetQuality.HIGHER, Factions.LUDDIC_PATH, FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE, chalcedon.getLocationInHyperspace());
245                triggerSetFleetOfficers(OfficerNum.MORE, OfficerQuality.HIGHER);
246                triggerMakeHostileAndAggressive();
247                triggerFleetMakeFaster(true, 2, true);
248                triggerSetFleetAlwaysPursue();
249                triggerPickLocationTowardsEntity(chalcedon.getStarSystem().getHyperspaceAnchor(), 30f, getUnits(1.5f));
250                triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation("$bffi_patherIntercept", null);
251                triggerOrderFleetInterceptPlayer();
252                triggerOrderFleetEBurn(1f);
253                triggerSetFleetMissionRef("$bffi_ref");
254                triggerFleetMakeImportant(null, Stage.INVESTIGATE_PATHER_STATION);
255                endTrigger();
256                
257                beginStageTrigger(Stage.COMPLETED);
258                triggerMakeNonStoryCritical("asher", "chalcedon", "olinadu", "kazeron", "gilead", "hesperus", "tartessus");
259                triggerSetGlobalMemoryValue("$bffi_missionCompleted", true);
260                endTrigger();
261                
262                return true;
263        }

265        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
266                        set("$bffi_stage", getCurrentStage());
267                        set("$bffi_patherStationSystem", patherBaseSystem.getName());
268        }

270        @Override
271        protected boolean callAction(String action, String ruleId, final InteractionDialogAPI dialog,
272                                                                 List<Token> params, final Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
273                
274                if ("spawnPatherBase".equals(action)) {
275                        //new LuddicPathBaseIntel(patherBaseSystem,  Factions.LUDDIC_PATH);
276                        
277                        patherStation = new LuddicPathBaseIntel(patherBaseSystem, Factions.LUDDIC_PATH);
278                        
279                        
280                        /* Don't need to actually simulate all of this.
281                        patherStation.getMarket().addIndustry("heavyindustry");
282                        MarketAPI patherMarket = patherStation.getMarket();
283                        String itemId = "corrupted_nanoforge";

287                        */              
288                        
289                        MemoryAPI mem = patherStation.getEntity().getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
290                        mem.set("$bffi_patherStationTarget", true);
291                        Global.getSector().addScript(patherStation);
292                        
293                        CampaignFleetAPI patherStationFleet = Misc.getStationFleet(patherStation.getMarket());
294                        patherStationFleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORED_BY_OTHER_FLEETS, true);
295                        patherStationFleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORES_OTHER_FLEETS, true);
296                        
297                        //makeImportant(patherStation, , Stage.INVESTIGATE_PATHER_STATION);
298                        Misc.makeImportant(patherStation.getEntity(), "$bffi_investigatePatherStation");
299                        Misc.addDefeatTrigger(patherStationFleet, "BFFIpatherStationDefeated");
300                        
301                        
302                        /*patherStationFleet.addEventListener(new BaseFleetEventListener() {
303                                @Override
304                                public void reportFleetDespawnedToListener(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, FleetDespawnReason reason, Object param) {
305                                        if (reason == FleetDespawnReason.DESTROYED_BY_BATTLE) {
306                                                // TODO something.
307                                                //fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$gaATG_hegScanFleet");
308                                                //encounterGateHegemony.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$GAATGhegemonyScanFleet");
309                                        }
310                                }
311                        });*/
312                        return true;
313                }
314                else if ("cleanUpPatherBase".equals(action)) {
315                
316                        if(patherStation != null) {
317                                Misc.makeUnimportant(patherStation.getEntity(), "$bffi_investigatePatherStation"); 
318                                // Is this implicit? probably. But also...
319                                
320                                CampaignFleetAPI patherStationFleet = Misc.getStationFleet(patherStation.getMarket());
321                                patherStationFleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORED_BY_OTHER_FLEETS);
322                        }
323                        
324                        
325                        return true;
326                }
327                else if ("patherBaseLosses".equals(action))
328                {
329                        // ui_cargo_special_tech_drop
330                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("explosion_from_damage", 1, 1, Global.getSoundPlayer().getListenerPos(), new Vector2f());
331                        return true;
332                }
333                else if ("shootEm".equals(action))
334                {
335                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("storyevent_diktat_execution", 1, 1, Global.getSoundPlayer().getListenerPos(), new Vector2f());
336                        return true;
337                }
338                else if ("ulmusPondMaskOff".equals(action)) { // unused, actually.
339                        ulmus_pond.setFaction("luddic_path"); // Whaaaaa????
340                        return true;
341                }
342                else if ("setCourseChalcedon".equals(action)) {
343                        Global.getSector().layInCourseFor(chalcedon.getPlanetEntity());
344                        return true;
345                }
346                else if ("doCleanup".equals(action))
347                {
348                        //Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$bffi_jethroCalledOutPond");
349                        //Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$bffi_intendToTalkHorus");         
350                        // Jeez, anything else?
351                        return true;
352                }
353                
354                return super.callAction(action, ruleId, dialog, params, memoryMap);
355        }

357        @Override
358        public void addDescriptionForNonEndStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
359                float opad = 10f;
360                //Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
361                
362                //Color h2 = Misc.getDarkHighlightColor();
363                //FactionAPI church = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH);
364                
365                //info.addImage(robed_man.getPortraitSprite(), width, 128, opad);
366
367                if (currentStage == Stage.PICK_UP_BORNANEW) {
368                        info.addPara("Pick up Jethro Bornanew from Gilead.", opad);
369                        addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", gilead, info, opad);
370                }
371                else if (currentStage == Stage.MEET_MENES_YARIBAY) {
372                        info.addPara("Go to Olinadu and contact Menes Yaribay, the planetary administrator.", opad);
373                        addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", olinadu, info, opad);
374                }
375                else if (currentStage == Stage.TALK_TO_HORUS) {
376                        info.addPara("Go to Kazeron and talk to Horus Yaribay about his cousin Menes.", opad);
377                        addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", kazeron, info, opad);
378                }
379                else if (currentStage == Stage.ATTEND_A_PARTY) {
380                        
381                        if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains("$bffi_intendToSteal")) {
382                                info.addPara("Attend Menes Yaribay's 'gathering' on Olinadu and find a way to steal the false relic.", opad);
383                                addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", olinadu, info, opad);
384                        }
385                        else if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains("$bffi_horusToParty")) {
386                                info.addPara("Attend Menes Yaribay's 'gathering' on Olinadu with Horus Yaribay, the patriarch of Gens Yaribay.", opad);
387                                addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", olinadu, info, opad);
388                        }
389                        else {
390                                info.addPara("Attend Menes Yaribay's 'gathering' on Olinadu and acquire the false relic.", opad);
391                                addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", olinadu, info, opad);
392                        }
393                }
394                else if (currentStage == Stage.TALK_TO_ENGINEER) {
395                        info.addPara("Bring the false relic to Asher so that a nanoforge engineer in the employ of the Church can examine it.", opad);
396                        addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", asher, info, opad);
397                }
398                else if (currentStage == Stage.TALK_TO_ULMUS_POND) {
399                        info.addPara("Go to Olinadu and confront Ulmus Pond to get a confession.", opad);
400                        addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", asher, info, opad);
401                }
402                else if (currentStage == Stage.GO_TO_CHALCEDON) {
403                        info.addPara("Go to Chalcedon and use Bornanew's intel to track down where Ulmus Pond is hiding.", opad);
404                        addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", chalcedon, info, opad);
405                }
406                else if (currentStage == Stage.INVESTIGATE_PATHER_STATION) {
407                        //info.addPara("Investigate the Pather Station in the " + patherStation.getSystem().getName() + " system and try to find out where their scan of the relic came from.", opad);
408                        //addStandardMarketDesc("Go to the Pather station " + patherStation.getMarket().getOnOrAt(), patherStation.getMarket(), info, opad);
409                        info.addPara(getGoToSystemTextShort(patherStation.getMarket().getStarSystem()) + " and investigate. Find where the glove came from and how it was made. Ensure no more will be created.",opad);
410                }
411                else if (currentStage == Stage.ARREST_THE_CURATE) {
412                        info.addPara("Go to the Cathedral of Holy Exodus, on Tartessus, and arrest Subcurate Cedra Keepfaith.", opad);
413                        addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", tartessus, info, opad);
414                }
415                else if (currentStage == Stage.DELIVER_KEEPFAITH) {
416                        info.addPara("Deliver Cedra Keepfaith to the Knights of Ludd on Hesperus to face their justice.", opad);
417                        addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", hesperus, info, opad);
418                }
419                else if (currentStage == Stage.GO_TO_HESPERUS) {
420                        if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains("$bffi_keepfaithEscapedTartessus")){
421                                info.addPara("Report back to Excubitor Orbis Gideon Oak on Hesperus with news of Bornanew's quest.", opad);
422                                addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", hesperus, info, opad);
423                        }
424                        else { //Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains("$bffi_returnBornanewBody"))
425                                info.addPara("Return Jethro Bornanew's body to the Knights of Ludd on Hesperus so he may rest with his fellow Knights.", opad);
426                                addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", hesperus, info, opad);
427                        }
428                }
429                else if (currentStage == Stage.RETURN_TO_HESPERUS_EARLY) {
430                        info.addPara("Report back to Excubitor Orbis Gideon Oak on Hesperus with news of Bornanew's quest.", opad);
431                        addStandardMarketDesc("Go to ", hesperus, info, opad);
432                }
433        }

435        @Override
436        public boolean addNextStepText(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
437                //Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
438                
439                if (currentStage == Stage.PICK_UP_BORNANEW) {
440                        info.addPara("Send a shuttle down to pick Novice Bornanew up from Gilead", tc, pad);
441                        return true;
442                }
443                else if (currentStage == Stage.MEET_MENES_YARIBAY) {
444                        info.addPara("Go to Olinadu and talk to the administrator, Menes Yaribay", tc, pad);
445                        return true;
446                }
447                else if (currentStage == Stage.TALK_TO_HORUS) {
448                        info.addPara("Go to Kazeron and talk to Horus Yaribay about Menes", tc, pad);
449                        return true;
450                }
451                else if (currentStage == Stage.ATTEND_A_PARTY) {
452                        if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains("$bffi_intendToSteal")) {
453                                info.addPara("Attend the 'gathering' organized by Menes Yaribay on Olinadu", tc, pad);
454                        }
455                        else {
456                                info.addPara("Attend the 'gathering' organized by Menes Yaribay on Olinadu", tc, pad);
457                        }
458                        
459                        return true;
460                }
461                else if (currentStage == Stage.TALK_TO_ENGINEER) {
462                        info.addPara("Bring the false relic to Asher to be examined by a nanoforge engineer", tc, pad);
463                        return true;
464                }
465                else if (currentStage == Stage.TALK_TO_ULMUS_POND) {
466                        info.addPara("Go to Olinadu and talk to Ulmus Pond", tc, pad);
467                        return true;
468                }
469                else if (currentStage == Stage.GO_TO_CHALCEDON) {
470                        info.addPara("Go to Chalcedon and find Ulmus Pond", tc, pad);
471                        return true;
472                }
473                else if (currentStage == Stage.INVESTIGATE_PATHER_STATION) {
474                        info.addPara("Go to " + patherStation.getSystem().getName() + " and find the source of the 'relic'.", tc, pad);
475                        return true;
476                }
477                else if (currentStage == Stage.ARREST_THE_CURATE) {
478                        info.addPara("Go to the Cathedral of Holy Exodus on Tartessus and arrest Subcurate Cedra Keepfaith", tc, pad);
479                        return true;
480                }
481                else if (currentStage == Stage.DELIVER_KEEPFAITH) {
482                        info.addPara("Bring Cedra Keeptfaith to Hesperus to face the justice of the Knights of Ludd", tc, pad);
483                        return true;
484                }
485                else if (currentStage == Stage.GO_TO_HESPERUS) {
486                        if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains("$bffi_keepfaithEscapedTartessus"))
487                        {
488                                info.addPara("Report back to Excubitor Orbis Gideon Oak on Hesperus", tc, pad);
489                        }
490                        else { //Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains("$bffi_returnBornanewBody"))
491                                info.addPara("Return Jethro Bornanew's body to the Knights of Ludd on Hesperus", tc, pad);
492                        }
493                        return true;
494                }
495                else if (currentStage == Stage.RETURN_TO_HESPERUS_EARLY) {
496                        info.addPara("Report back to Excubitor Orbis Gideon Oak on Hesperus", tc, pad);
497                        return true;
498                }
499                
500                /*
501                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
502                if (currentStage == Stage.DROP_OFF) {
503                        info.addPara("Deliver " + getWithoutArticle(thing) + " to specified location in the " +  
504                                        system.getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort(), tc, pad);
505                        return true;
506                }
507                */
508                return false;
509        }
